channel.title: Epic Fury Live — US-Iran War Tracker
channel.description: Live tracking of the US-Israel-Iran conflict. Real-time updates, verified casualties, evidence, and analysis.

item.title: Analyst says what attacks on Lebanon could mean for potential US-Iran deal
item.description: Israeli affairs analyst Dan Perry explains how the US, Israel and Iran may react as they get closer to an agreement.

item.title: Trump condemns Israel’s attack on Beirut, says Iran deal still close
item.description: Donald Trump says there should be 'no more attacks' by Israel or Hezbollah on 'special day' when deal could be signed.

item.title: Anticipation, pushback in Iran as mediators work to finalise deal with US
item.description: Israel attacked Beirut again in an apparent attempt to test and derail an agreement.

item.title: Israel attacks Beirut on same day Trump says Iran deal to be signed
item.description: Israel has bombed the southern suburbs of Beirut, saying it targeted Hezbollah ‘infrastructure’.

item.title: At least three killed as Israel attacks southern Beirut
item.description: Israeli escalation in Lebanon's capital raises concerns that peace negotiations between US and Iran could be derailed.

item.title: Will the US-Iran deal be signed on Sunday? What we know so far
item.description: US says a deal to stop the war on Iran could be signed as early as Sunday. Tehran, however, disputes the timeline.

item.title: Lebanon says three killed in Israeli strike on Beirut suburb
item.description: Israel says it targeted the Iran-backed Hezbollah, as Tehran warns this could derail a US-Iran deal to end the fighting.

item.title: Russian families use AI to 'resurrect' loved ones killed in Ukraine
item.description: The highly controversial trend lies at the intersection of Russia's war on Ukraine, new AI technologies and grief.

item.title: US kills leader of Venezuela's Tren de Aragua gang in air strike, Trump says
item.description: Niño Guerrero was killed in a "swift and lethal kinetic strike," the US President wrote in a social media post.
